bio.text: Mitch Rosenwald represents District 98 in the Florida House of Representatives, to which Rosenwald was elected in 2024.
Rosenwald served on the Oakland Park city commission from 2020 to 2024, including as vice mayor (2022-2023) and mayor (2023-2024).
Rosenwald is a university professor born in Towson, Maryland, who moved to Florida in 2007 and lives in Oakland Park. Rosenwald holds a PhD from the University of Maryland, Baltimore (2004).
